# Brief: Wrenfield Analytics (fictional sample)

A sample plan filled in to the standard we aim for. Wrenfield is a made-up web analytics product, and
every name, number and URL here is fictional. Copy the shape, not the words.

## Their brief (verbatim, do not edit)

> none: internal demo. Our own launch video for the new assistant.

## Our reading

- **Goal:** a small team's growth lead believes they can set Wrenfield up in a few minutes and get a
  straight answer about last week's signups without building a report.
- **Audience:** founders and growth leads at small software companies. They know what a signup
  funnel is. They do not want another dashboard to babysit.
- **Where it runs:** Wrenfield web app, sandbox workspace "Harbor Studio" (app.example.com).
- **Videos wanted:** promo (about 1:30), how-to (about 3:00), social 9:16 of the assistant scene.
- **Must show on screen:**
  - Setup is one tracking snippet and one read-only key (scenes 01, 02).
  - The assistant answers from the team's own data, with the numbers visible (scene 04).
  - Test traffic can be hidden, and the numbers change when it is (scene 05).
  - A teammate sees the same report without an editor seat (scenes 06, 07).
  - When there is no data, the assistant says so instead of guessing (scene 08).
- **Must not say or show:** "real time" (data lands within a few minutes, not instantly);
  "AI-powered insights" or any claim of accuracy beyond what the answer on screen shows; any real
  company, person, email or key.
- **Voiceover:** yes. ElevenLabs (`--voice elevenlabs`, the user asked for it), else macOS `say` for the timing pass.
- **Deadline:** none set.

## Claims list

| Claim | Proved by |
| --- | --- |
| "Set up in a few minutes" | 01 and 02, uncut in the how-to, under three minutes of footage |
| "Ask in plain words" | 04: the question is typed as a person would say it |
| "From your own data" | 04: the answer quotes 1,240 signups, the same number as the dashboard in 03 |
| "Hide test traffic in one switch" | 05: visits drop from 18,960 to 17,402 on screen |
| "Share without an extra seat" | 06 and 07: Sam is invited as Viewer and sees the report |
| "It tells you when it does not know" | 08: the assistant says there is no data before 3 March |

## Open questions for the requester

- None. Internal demo; sandbox workspace; everything created on camera is listed in THROWAWAYS.md.
